component.name: HimVote Linux
component.summary: Institutional election client and independent cryptographic auditor

description.p: HimVote Linux provides transparent, verifiable student and institutional democracy. It features independent election browsing, cryptographic receipt tracking, offline RFC 9162 Merkle tree verification, and automated candidate tally recomputation.

ul.li: Browse official institutional elections and verified candidate manifestos
Track 4-stage cryptographic receipt evidence: Submitted, Accepted, Witnessed, and Anchored
Perform standalone offline election audits from zipped or directory archives without server trust
Interactive Merkle inclusion proof visualization with animated hashing progression
Reproducible audit report export in Markdown and JSON conforming to Section 6.8
High-contrast accessibility theme conforming to WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast ratios

description.p: Production release with 5-view institutional suite, candidate bio modals, and reproducible audit export.
